#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    vector<long long> sl(51, 0);
    sl[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; ++i) {
        sl[i] = sl[i - 1] + (1LL << i);
    }

    int h, n;
    cin >> h >> n;

    n += sl[h - 1];
    vector<long long> nl;
    nl.push_back(n);
    while (n != 1) {
        n /= 2;
        nl.push_back(n);
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    long long cn = 1;
    bool cp = false;

    while (cn != nl[0]) {
        vector<long long> tnl;
        long long current = cn;
        for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
            tnl.push_back(current);
            if (!cp) {
                current *= 2;
            } else {
                current = current * 2 + 1;
            }
            cp = !cp;
        }
        if (current == nl[0]) {
            ans += h;
            break;
        }
        tnl.push_back(current);
        reverse(tnl.begin(), tnl.end());
        for (int i = 1; i <= h; ++i) {
            if (nl[i] == tnl[i]) {
                ans += sl[i - 1] + h - i + 1;
                h = i - 1;
                cn = tnl[i - 1];
                if (cn == tnl[i] * 2) {
                    cn = tnl[i] * 2 + 1;
                    cp = false;
                } else {
                    cn = tnl[i] * 2;
                    cp = true;
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
